decisions.reason: Locates the session.events reads in plugin-source-excerpt.js, traces the crash chain to undefined being iterated in crash-stack.txt, and cites the changelog for removal at 0.1.2-alpha.4 with seq/eventAt/snapshotEvents replacements.

Explains alpha.5 satisfies ^0.1.2-alpha.2 as a same-tuple prerelease ordering fact while npm only evaluates declared version metadata, never API existence or runtime behavior; peer range is an untested author claim.
Five genuinely distinct classes explained: symbol removal, value-shape/type change, semantic/lifecycle (incl. sync-async), loader/manifest contract change, duplicate-instance identity failure.

Requires matrix-testing every version the range admits with a startup smoke test, then narrowing the peer range to the tested band and adding a feature-detection guard with correct old (events array) and new (snapshotEvents/seq) paths; clarifies engines covers Node only.

Concrete checks tied to the Session.events incident: throwaway-prefix boot probe, publish-time vs release-timeline comparison, and grepping the plugin source for .events against the installed host's actual API surface.

caps.reason: The report explicitly identifies and rejects the satisfied-range-implies-compatibility inference; its final conclusions never claim install success proves runtime compatibility.
